dateMeaning: Dates identify source snapshot capture, not this page visit or registry rebuild. Different tests may have different capture dates.
coverageMeaning: Counts describe results imported into ChipIndex. They do not measure the size or complete coverage of an external benchmark archive.

sources.name: SPEC CPU
sources.label: Imported snapshot
sources.description: Published server CPU results for integer and floating-point throughput.
sources.accessMethod: Official result indexes and full system disclosures; the importer scans available rate-result archives and retains a disclosed selection of exact catalog matches.
limitations: Scores describe a complete submitted system, including its CPU count, memory, compiler and operating system.
CPU2017 and CPU2026 use separate scales. Compare the same suite, metric, base result and CPU count.

Archive indexes are scanned for catalog matches. CPU2017 retains the latest two reports per model and CPU count plus previously verified reports; this is not every system submission. CPU2026 test builds stay separate.
sources.rightsNote: Retain the full result link, exact metric and system context; follow SPEC's fair-use and reporting rules.

refresh.note: Replays retained source captures. Add --allow-network for live archive discovery and report retrieval; full report capture is an explicit importer option.

sources.name: MLPerf Inference
sources.label: Imported snapshot
sources.description: AI inference throughput from submitted datacenter systems running Llama 2 70B.
sources.accessMethod: Official MLCommons summary JSON retained with its revision, capture timestamp and content hash. The importer accounts for every source row and keeps the selected comparison cohort.
limitations: Results describe a whole system with eight accelerators, not one accelerator.
Server measures throughput under response-time constraints; Offline measures batch throughput. Keep their charts separate.
The selection is v6.0, Closed, Available, Llama 2 70B 99%, one node. Software, host CPUs and precision can differ.
Hardware identities that cannot be resolved to one catalog product remain in the exclusion review.
sources.rightsNote: Preserve submission context and follow MLCommons result messaging and trademark guidance.

refresh.note: Captures the official v6.0 summary and rebuilds both scenarios with validation. Offline replay retains the original capture date.

datasets.label: AI serving · Llama 2 70B Server
datasets.scope: Published whole-system Server throughput for one-node systems with exactly eight accelerators.

datasets.label: Batch inference · Llama 2 70B Offline
datasets.scope: Published whole-system Offline throughput for one-node systems with exactly eight accelerators.

sources.name: Blender Open Data
sources.label: Imported snapshot
sources.description: CPU and GPU rendering speed in Blender's Cycles renderer, summarized by device model.
sources.accessMethod: Official grouped JSON export retained with a content hash. Blender also publishes downloadable daily raw snapshots under CC0.
limitations: These are Blender 5.2.0 device medians with at least five submissions, across mixed operating systems and compute backends.
The score is rendering samples per minute; it does not measure gaming, general responsiveness or AI performance.
Only unique exact catalog models are matched. Unspecified memory variants and unmatched laptop GPUs stay excluded.
sources.rightsNote: Blender's downloadable raw dataset is CC0. Retain source links and aggregation context.

refresh.note: Captures Blender's official grouped export, records its hash and capture time, and rebuilds exact catalog matches. Offline replay retains that capture date.

datasets.label: CPU and GPU rendering · Blender 5.2.0
datasets.scope: Blender 5.2.0; all operating systems and compute types

sources.name: Phoronix / OpenBenchmarking
sources.label: Not connected
sources.description: Application-specific tests such as compilation, compression, databases and scientific computing.
sources.accessMethod: Phoronix Test Suite provides saved result exports, including JSON and CSV. No ChipIndex importer is connected.
limitations: Phoronix Test Suite runs many independent test profiles; there is no single Phoronix score.
An import needs the exact test profile version, options, units, score direction and system configuration.
Public result access and an open-source test runner do not establish permission to republish every hosted result.
sources.rightsNote: Review hosted-result terms and the chosen export's permitted use before importing.

refresh.note: No imported results. Export selection and a compatible result adapter are required.

sources.name: PassMark
sources.label: Not connected
sources.description: Broad CPU and graphics comparisons from PerformanceTest submissions.
sources.accessMethod: PassMark offers licensed CPU and GPU CSV data downloads. A licensed feed and a ChipIndex adapter are not connected.
limitations: The published data-licensing terms restrict redistribution and reproduction of PassMark's benchmark charts.
Permission for this site's intended public display must be established with PassMark before a feed is imported.
A public score page or PerformanceTest upload API key is not a licensed data feed.
sources.rightsNote: Data access and permitted public display depend on the licensing agreement.

refresh.note: No imported results. The standard subscription excludes public ranking sites. No import is planned without a specific written grant.
